summary: Samsung bundles Galaxy AI features (Live Translate, Summarize, Circle to Search, Photo Assist) behind a single settings screen with per-feature toggles. You can turn them all off or pick and choose.

steps.path: Settings → Galaxy AI (or Settings → Advanced features → Advanced Intelligence on some devices)
Turn off each sub-menu toggle: Call assist, Browsing assist, Interpreter, Summarization, etc.
Some features also have toggles inside their respective apps (Camera, Gallery, Notes, Phone, Samsung Messages, Samsung Health)

collateral: some AI features like Circle to Search are also controlled by Google — disabling Galaxy AI may not fully disable those
certain system-level AI integrations may remain active even after toggling off all visible settings
whyTheyDidIt: Samsung wants Galaxy AI as a device-selling differentiator, especially for the S24/S25 line.
